$schema_doc._about: Tier A board layout for The Drawdown Protocol (docs/Phase_3/03_Board_Rendering_Spec.md). Hand-authored data, loaded once by BoardView._ready() via JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(...)). All coordinates are plain pixels at design_resolution; with the project set to stretch mode 'canvas_items', aspect 'keep', base size 1920x1080, they are valid Node2D positions at any window size - no runtime scaling math.
$schema_doc.version: Integer schema version. Bump only on a breaking field change.
$schema_doc.design_resolution: {w,h} reference resolution the coordinates are authored at.
$schema_doc.hud_reserved: Screen rects {x,y,w,h} owned by the HUD CanvasLayer (top pillar/warming bar, right inspector+log dock, bottom card tray). Informative contract: HUD scenes anchor themselves via Control layout; BoardView must simply never place anything inside these rects.
$schema_doc.board_area: Usable board rect {x,y,w,h}. Invariant: every panel rect (pos +/- panel_size/2) stays inside it. 16-24 px breathing gap to every HUD zone.
$schema_doc.panel_size: The one shared RegionPanel footprint {w,h} in px. Also the hover hit rect (Control-based panels per docs/Phase_3/04_Interaction_Spec.md); sized so the 1.02 hover scale and selection outline never overlap a neighbour.
$schema_doc.panel_origin: 'center': slot pos is the CENTER of the panel. Build the RegionPanel scene around its own origin so hover-scale and event-flash tweens pivot from the middle.
$schema_doc.slots: One entry per region, keyed by the stable region_id from docs/Phase_3/01_World_Model_And_Tile_Schema.md (region_00..region_11, index order; region_00 is always the player home, assigned first per 02_Procedural_Generation_Spec.md step 1). Archetypes are rolled per seed, so slots are archetype-agnostic. Array order = child/draw order, back to front (ascending y). Fields per slot: region_id (StringName key), pos {x,y} panel center in px, band ('north'|'mid'|'south'|'ocean' - which stylized world zone the slot evokes; usable for staggered intro reveals or era-tint ripples, no gameplay meaning), tooltip_side ('top'|'bottom'|'left'|'right' - the side the 0.3 s hover tooltip opens toward so it never clips a screen edge or a HUD zone).
$schema_doc.decor_arcs: OPTIONAL cosmetic pairs [from_region_id, to_region_id]. The view MAY draw them as faint dashed background curves so the board reads as one connected world. They are NEVER gameplay adjacency - there is no geography simulation (03_Board_Rendering_Spec.md); ignoring this array is always safe.
